participation.context: Read the title, and went in.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

relations.note: a bill read, and not a house attended

story.body: You read The First Part of Hercules on a bill at the door. You did not read what the house took.

relations.note: a bill read, and not a house attended

title: Read The First Part of Hercules at the Theatre door

participation.context: Named the gowns, the thin yard, and the giant over the water.
participation.name: Goodwife Margery Pell

participation.context: Raye reported the end, the skin, the mast, and the monsters, and swore no height.
participation.name: William Blackwage, Ralph Raye, Richard Hoope

participation.context: Asked how tall, scowled into the cup, and refused a club.
participation.name: Richard Burbage

participation.context: Asked the timber, forbade a sum, and named ten shillings and the second of June.
participation.name: James Burbage

participation.context: Said he had not gone, kept the king at home, and left.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Named as the man in the skin. He was not in the room.
participation.name: Edward Alleyn

relations.note: no invented timber, and the wage he does know

story.body: You heard the giant from Pell and the lion's skin from Raye. Burbage asked a height nobody swore. James asked a timber cost nobody had, and he named the ten shillings he does pay. You went home to write, with the king unannounced.

relations.note: no invented timber, and the wage he does know

title: Heard of Alleyn in a lion's skin
